profile_text.body:
Palo Alto Networks is a publicly traded cybersecurity company (NASDAQ: PANW, CIK 0001327567) that describes itself as a leader in cybersecurity protection and software for modern enterprises. Its site positions the company as serving a range of security professionals, including CISOs, network security engineers, cloud architects, and SOC managers, with offerings spanning network security, cloud workload protection, hybrid workforce security, threat intelligence, and security consulting. The company describes its approach as built around Zero Trust architecture and AI-driven automation.

The company's tracked AI product is Palo Alto Networks Precision AI, categorized under Security and Identity AI, with noted capabilities including network security AI, Zero Trust integration, autonomous threat response, and coverage of critical infrastructure environments. The site also references the Strata Network Security Platform, described as built for Zero Trust and powered by AI to monitor, analyze, and prevent threats in real time, as well as an AI-driven SecOps platform aimed at transforming security operations centers through unified data, artificial intelligence, and automation. A product called Idira is introduced on the site as a next-generation identity security platform designed to secure every identity for what the company terms the AI enterprise.

No litigation cases or MCP server registrations are present in the held data for Palo Alto Networks.
